page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.6xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores using the x86_64 architecture. The processor is an Intel Xeon 8369B running at 2.7 GHz, supported by 96.0 GB of RAM, which translates to 4.0 GB of memory per core. The CPU cache configuration includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.g7.6xlarge demonstrates consistent mid-tier performance. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is recorded at 1836.29, while the multi-core performance reaches 23245.48. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1267.06 GB/sec, dropping to 128.31 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, with write speeds at 63.76 GB/sec. The instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1544.0 and a multi-core score of 11454.0. Notably, the server shows strong performance in LLM text generation using a small 135M model, reaching 282.28 tokens/sec, which falls into the top 25% category, though prompt processing for the same model averages 1803.7 tokens/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 memory-to-vCPU ratio provide a stable resource density for workloads requiring predictable compute performance without the overhead of GPU or local storage bundling. The hardware profile is suited for general-purpose workloads, including static web serving (which benchmarked at 27.21 GB/sec), database operations (Passmark database score of 11534.69), software compilation, and Redis deployments, where it handles 23.41 million SET operations per second.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.6xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance featuring 24 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB per core, and operates on the KVM hypervisor. The instance lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, relying on a 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Performance benchmarks place the server in the average tier for most compute and memory tasks, with a Passmark CPU score of 28981.96 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 11454.0. It exhibits strong performance in text generation for small language models, achieving 282.28 tokens/sec. Given its balanced resource allocation and dedicated CPU execution, the ecs.g7.6xlarge is suited for multi-threaded applications, database operations, static web serving, and software compilation.
